t.E903.agn: In 2012 EFSA stated that there is no concern for genotoxicity and that no adverse effects were seen in short-term, reproductive and developmental studies. As long-term data were not available, it did not set an ADI, but, considering the margin of safety sufficient, concluded that there is no safety concern at the authorised uses. JECFA had set an ADI of 7 mg/kg body weight/day.
t.E903.body: Not expected to be absorbed to a significant extent.
t.E903.found.1: Confectionery (max. 500 mg/kg) and chewing gum (max. 1,200 mg/kg)
t.E903.found.2: Surface of unpeeled coloured boiled eggs
t.E903.found.3: Coffee beans, snacks and food supplements
t.E903.prod: A wax obtained and purified from the leaves and buds of the Brazilian wax palm.
t.E903.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no ADI set, no safety concern at the authorised uses.
t.E903.summary: A plant wax obtained from the leaves of the carnauba palm. A glazing agent in confectionery, dragées and fruit.
t.E903.what: A plant wax obtained from the carnauba palm (Copernicia cerifera) in Brazil; used as a glazing agent.
